name: com.uindies.tablescrollviewer
description: A recyclable scroll-list extension for Unity uGUI. Recycles only visible nodes, supports keyboard / gamepad / mouse / touch navigation via an OnKeyDown input hook, custom per-row sizes, focus effects, sub-nodes, scrollbar auto fade and table add/remove/update.

samples.description: Vertical, horizontal and scene2 sample scenes with node prefabs, TMP resources and textures demonstrating how to drive a TableScrollViewer (uses TextMeshPro).
